steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Everyone! Everybody! Would you look at that!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Before this match began, who could've known that this fight—this standoff between the renowned Nearl family and the Plastic Knight—would've turned out like this?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Maria Nearl! The girl who inherited the Nearl name! Who could've seen this coming—!?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: She's completely cornered by Szewczyk! And she's got no way to turn the tables!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: That won't do! Nearl! Do you know how much money our audience has bet on you just because of your name?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Uh... Say that again? Oh, it's not actually that much, going by where the the odds stand? Hey now, you should all have a little more faith in the girl! Isn't her face worth something to you?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ughh—!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I was expecting something on Zofia or the Radiant Knight's level, but is this all you've got...?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: What a let-down.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: That's the Roar Guards' old war horse! He's using the artificial environment and his speed to his advantage! The poor girl's got nowhere to run!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: He stops! He shoots! And then he's on the move again! This is his 'Plastic Rhythm'!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (I-I can't see his movements! Why? He's not even as fast as Zofia—)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (He stopped! I've gotta block—!)

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Too slow!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —Maria! To your left!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: What—Uhgh!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Szewczyk just hopped on the wall there and made a beautiful burst of shots. My god, if he landed those shots where he really wanted them, we'd have to cut the broadcast short! That was close!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Even though he's been hit a few times already, his armor is so tough, there's absolutely no sign of damage at all! Yet he's able to move around in it so quickly! Astounding!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: You see that, everyone? That's the latest product from the Roar Guards! The Jack 2 Special High Performance Rubber Paste!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This fantastic product can be yours today! But wait! We're even handing out 5% off coupons at the front of the arena right now! Be sure not to miss this opportunity!
So... That's Nearl?
Hold on, is she really the Radiant Knight's sister?
...What, are you disappointed?
Of course not... Why would I be disappointed by something like this? What about you?
Me? Well... Let's keep watching a little longer. We paid good money for our tickets after all.
I hate the atmosphere here... and Mob never fails to get on my nerves.
I don't understand how he manages to stir up the crowd when he commentates like that... And those advertisements... Is anyone actually running out to buy anything he's advertising?
There's probably a few.
After all, letting viewers put everything off their minds and go with the crowd is what these knight competitions do best, wouldn't you agree?
Hey, take a look over there. In the front row. 'Whislash' Zofia.
Not just her. There's more over there... Some lesser-known knights.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: ...We have about ten minutes left.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Looks like your luck hasn't run out yet. If I didn't have to drag this out, you would've begged me to spare your life long ago!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Nngh—!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Just surrender, kid.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You don't know the rules here. The judges aren't going to stop us until I have arrows sticking through all your arms and legs.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You don't need to do this. Throw in the towel.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I-I can't give up...!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Well, if you've already dug your heels in... You have her eyes, but, other than that, you're nothing.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Very well... Let's see how long you can keep this up.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Training is nothing like real combat.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No one's going to try to be polite and take you head-on.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Besides, each contestant has her own equipment, weapon, and fighting style. On top of that, each battle takes place on different terrain, there are different traps and support equipment... Any one of which could influence the outcome.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Gathering intel sounds really important...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's right, and that's where the problem is. There is no way you can remember the weaknesses of each and every one of the knights in the Kazimierz Major, but most if not all of them have their eyes on you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ohh...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: There isn't a one-size-fits-all solution when it comes to winning the competitions, but if we have to come up with something...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Bring out the best in yourself—In other words, give it your all.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: So, you mean... you've got nothing?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ow!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Observe and think. You don't come up with solutions before you actually face the challenges.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You need to analyze the situation within an extremely short amount of time and come up with the appropriate response. That's not an easy thing to do.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —To the left!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You got lucky there.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ohh?! This is the first time Nearl has countered his attack—Nope, all she did was block his feint!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The vote count hasn't changed! Szewczyk still has the advantage, and an overwhelming one at that!
Observe. Think.
Maria—
You are gifted with a pair of pegasian eyes.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (His knight armor—Jack 2?)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (The Roar Guards have thirteen different products, and none are called that—)

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: ...Waiting for me to strike? Fool!
Several arrows buzz past Maria, sending strands of hair fluttering in the air and leaving behind a trail of smoke and dust in the air.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (It enhances his mobility... No, there's more to it than that... but this model...)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Let's give it a try.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: She's charging! 'Plastic' Szewczyk has been toying with Nearl so far this entire match, but she's finally charging him for the first time!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: She dodged the flames burning through the crevices and the artificial frost! She's fast! Very fast—But Szewczyk is still not moving away! Is he going to fight her head on?!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: It's suicide for an archer to fight a swordsman head on—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You won't get away—!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I'm not going anywhere!
The two contestants clash. Arrows whiz past Maria as she endures the intense pain on her face, yet she does not attack.
She steps atop her opponent's armor and flips into the air. Naturally, Szewczyk did not expect the confrontation to be this friendly—
The coldness he feels in his hand, the low roar, and the unnatural smoke wafting in the air—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What's this? Would you believe it?! We aren't just getting a knight match for our money today; we've got a circus show going on here!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Maria has finally closed in on Szewczyk, but she hasn't attacked even once! Is this her idea of a taunt?!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...It's not that she's not attacking; she can't attack. If she didn't dodge that, her left arm would've been crippled by now.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Plastic's trying to drag the fight on. He's trying to get sponsorships by putting on a show... *sigh*.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria...

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: What... did you just do?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: It's getting a little hot in here, isn't it... Mr. Szewczyk?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Haven't the Roar Guards thought out the ventilation issues in that new armor you're wearing?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: ...That's something for the craftsmen to worry about, not for two dueling knights to have a discussion over.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (High performance, lightweight... It's obviously trying to replicate that high-end Victorian workmanship and the Originium skeletal reinforcement lining technology from Columbia...)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (They probably left out air vents because of some technical issues... No, maybe just aesthetics...)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (In that case... How much longer till it reaches its limits?)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (He moves and shoots, then repeats. I know his pattern, but I can't match his speed.)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Wait, no... He moves, then stops, and then he shoots... Hold on...?)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: We had a little interlude just now, but both sides have regained their composure! They pulled away from each other, and we're back on track—Hang on!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Maria's not hesitating at all! She took off right away and she's trying to match Szewczyk's speed! But! There's still some difference between them!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You don't know when to give up, do you? Hasn't 'Whislash' taught you not to make chase when you have the lower hand in speed?
Szewczyk briskly stops and turns. In no time, he has already replaced his bowstring.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Now!)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A flash! The stadium is suddenly filled with a blinding light—Let's take this opportunity to look at all the advantages of Raythean's latest sunglasses, part of its Pioneer line of apparel!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (What? Advertisements? Who gives a crap when they've already thrown all that money on this?)

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Nnn—!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: She's not attacking—What—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (He's not attacking or moving! Again!)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —Hiyaah!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: He blocked it! Szewczyk, a crossbowman, managed to block Maria's attack without even breaking a sweat!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Our Nascent Nearl, Maria, is running out of ideas!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (I knew it!)

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: So the Arts were all just a fluke... Was there even a point to that? It was your last chance.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Mr. Szewczyk, how's the automatic cooling system doing for you during combat?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Well, color me surprised... If you figured that out so quickly, maybe you should've been a mechanic, not a knight.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —Mr. Szewczyk, you're a really strong knight. Your speed and techniques are impeccable.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Sadly, it looks like you chose to be a corporate product tester instead.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: ...None of your business, and I suggest you stop underestimating the Roar Guards' technological prowess.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —Is that so?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ohh?! Maria's willingly pulled herself back! What's the meaning of this?! What were the two of them talking about?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I'm sure our audience is curious about that, too. I've always been an advocate for giving the knights mics—Who doesn't want to listen in on our contestants trash-talking each other?!
Well, the crowd's getting all fired up again.
It seems like Maria Nearl figured something out.
Yeah, it looks like it. Well, no matter. Knights should spend more time thinking instead of always trying to brute force a win.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Cheap tricks...!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: He stops! He shoots! Szewczyk's starting his hunt again—Wait! Maria sidestepped the obstacles on the ground, and she's dashing straight towards Szewczyk!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Hmm?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Szewczyk! Szewczyk's not moving an inch! Is he going to take that hit straight on like last time?!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: *Warning sounds* Tsk! This stupid cooling system—!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Sorry about this!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Don't get cocky!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Ugh?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: It's suicide for an archer to fight a swordsman head on—I couldn't have said it better myself!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: (It hasn't cooled down yet. I need to keep my distance!)

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Out of the way!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Szewczyk—! Unbelievable! With just his crossbow and his bayonet, he blocked her flawlessly!
Maria closes her eyes.
She has seen this technique countless times, and she has tried to imitate it just as many.
A move she has copied over and over and over.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Yeah... now I remember...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That backhand thrust... It's the same one that took Margaret to victory.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: This is impossible...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Haghhh—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Th-That hurts...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: —Wh-Who could've seen this coming?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Szewczyk still had the advantage just a second ago, but she knocked him cold in just one blow! There is no question. The winner is Maria!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: But how did she do that? Did we just witness a repeat of that miraculous final match?! Maria Nearl! Has she been hiding her true strength this whole time?!
Well, well. She did it.
...Let's go.
Not gonna keep watching?
What's there to watch? Better go home and fix up your weapon, don't leave any weaknesses for your opponent to capitalize on.
Hahaha, you're right about that. Wait up!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria... you really did it.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Is this really a good thing?
Mr. Mob.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (Hey! This stage's for commentators! Get off!)
Shh... Quiet. Do not let the audience hear you... They cannot see me where I am standing, so relax.
I am just here to relay Mr. Pavel's thoughts on the matter...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Pa... Y-You dare call him by name... What do you want?
It appears Szewczyk lost this match out of ineptitude. This has been a huge disappointment to the Roar Guards Company.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: You mean...
Quiet now... There are some things that are best kept unsaid. I am sure you are aware what that means.
Now go, the audience is waiting.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Everyone—! Everyone!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Going by the odds and votes, this has undoubtedly been a huge upset! This match is sure to be the talk of the town for days to come!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: An independent, untitled knight managed to defeat the Roar K.C.'s vanguard! It looks like Maria Nearl's Originium Arts are a force to be reckoned with! She defeated the 'Plastic' Szewczyk, through pure skill!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Was it because Szewczyk underestimated her opponent, a newbie? Was it their conversation that determined the victor? This is why I said the knights should get mics—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: In any case! Whatever excuses you've got, it's all too late now! I'm honored to announce the results of the first match of the day!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The winner—Maria Nearl!
